Method of Attack: Adding containers running Monero mining script
Spreading via scripts and utilities on target system ('living off the land')
Downloading and launching mining scripts from Pastebin
Impacted Systems: Docker hosts with exposed TCP ports 2375 or 2376
Attack Vector: Exploiting misconfigured Docker services with unauthenticated REST APIs on TCP ports 2375 and 2376
Indicators of Compromise: Mining script variant hosted on Pastebin
